purpose: Pipeline fixtures for the existing behaviour feature extractor and detectors. Not a real-world evaluation set and not a train/test split.
time_convention: Tracking JSON has no timestamp. frame_id increases by fps once per second. Member 3 uses frame_id / fps when a timestamp is absent.
zone_convention: Tracking JSON has no zone field. The foot point is the bottom centre of bbox and is placed inside the polygons in configs/zones.json.
label_basis: Motion plan written by this generator. Not detector output and not a human review.
object_interaction: Possible concealment has a separate Member 1 detection file. A missing file or a file with only person boxes is rejected.
